status: Exploratory completed-development addendum; source only, not submission-ready paper
results_boundary: Completed v0.8 capture metadata, source-only development annotation/adjudication, and pinned scorer execution with separate independent arithmetic/native-process audit. v0.7 aggregate instability is identified explicitly as preceding evidence. No decoder accuracy result on v0.8 source histories.
source_quotation_policy: No verbatim source excerpts in this addendum; source interpretation claims are bounded paraphrases of recorded review findings.

publication_status.latex_toolchain_limit: Prior check found no pdflatex format/classes; no installation attempted.

claims.claim: All 39 URLs were attempted; 32 provisionally usable sources cover 15 complete source sets. Preselection of four histories/eight prefixes yielded three ready histories/six prefixes after IBM capture failures, without replacement.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Capture feasibility is not benchmark admission or certification of independent histories. Failed and blocked records remain disclosed.

claims.claim: Docker prefix 1 already contains a later reversal update; HS2 lacks an independently captured original erroneous version. Author-defined current-document prefixes do not certify historical knowledge.
claims.scope_and_caveat: No source text is retroactively removed to simulate an unavailable original; version hashes authenticate captured bytes, not historical availability.

claims.claim: Six initial annotation generations and six separate reference generations cover three histories and six prefixes, 57 claim instances, and 12 judgments from six unique question texts.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Unknown model revisions remain null. Fresh-context roles are procedural separation, not independent training or human gold. Repeated prefixes and question texts are not independent samples.

claims.claim: Four annotation artifacts changed; all six reference artifacts were retained. Unsupported Docker corrections, imprecise reversal timing, Chrome banner stance, and unsupported Chrome ordering were addressed. Selected annotations retain 57 claim instances; all 12 selected artifacts validate structurally.
claims.scope_and_caveat: The one initial date-precision failure and all raw outputs remain disclosed. Review judgments are model-assisted and do not establish completeness, human accuracy, or world truth.

claims.claim: HS2 supports a reported 81-to-41 percent correction with changed compensation scope and a later Manchester plan change; a complete latest-source Leeds disposition remains unestablished. These do not demonstrate natural-data joint-inference benefit.
claims.scope_and_caveat: The old percentage is quoted as erroneous, not active current-world support. Source annotations are not scored candidate graphs; no pre-correction original or cross-document propagation experiment is claimed.

claims.claim: The v0.7 aggregate result had 26/32 sign changes. The v0.8 follow-up fixes the first item per kind, four dependent items from one already inspected history.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Selection did not inspect item-level outcomes, but experiment design followed observed aggregate instability. No held-out or independent four-example benchmark claim.

claims.claim: Eight fresh processes collected 16 cold/warm distributions with original prompts, fixed label meanings, pinned Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0/runtime files, complete token accounting, and full-vocabulary next-token Yes/No probabilities.
claims.scope_and_caveat: The runtime is file-pinned, not hermetic; literal-label log odds are uncalibrated additive scores. Fresh process state does not reset the operating-system file cache.

claims.claim: All four cold label-order comparisons flip score sign; absolute order differences range from 3.211095940321684 to 8.131506235862616 natural-log units. All eight immediate warm repeats match both archived label log probabilities exactly. Independent replay passed native-binding and arithmetic checks.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Equality is at stored output precision in this runtime. Cache carryover is not sufficient for these four effects; nothing establishes general invariance, the cause of all 32 earlier effects, accuracy, statistical significance, or model-independent behavior.

claims.claim: Further source-grouped evaluation needs stronger reference adjudication, candidate coverage measurement, a stronger pinned contextual baseline, and shared candidates/scores across decoders; optimization and question accuracy must be separated.
claims.scope_and_caveat: Prospective gate only. No human gold, held-out accuracy, natural joint-decoding gain, strong baseline result, or new method claim is supplied.

claims.claim: The addendum is source-only and supplements unchanged v0.7 manuscript/BibTeX. Full captured text and verbatim working artifacts are subject to separate redistribution constraints; hashes cannot reconstruct unavailable inputs.
claims.scope_and_caveat: No compiled or visually checked PDF is claimed. Hash-bound metadata is not a raw-text reproduction of external annotation requests.
